head.h1: Corporate Catering in Dubai — What It Costs and How to Book

opening_paragraph: Corporate catering in Dubai costs from AED 90 per person for a working lunch and AED 700 to 950 with a chef on site . MyCHEF quotes to your exact headcount, menu and service level. A vetted chef and team handle the cooking, the service and the setup, from a ten-seat boardroom lunch to a 300-guest gala.

Send the brief and we typically reply within 15 minutes during business hours, with an itemised proposal to follow you can forward straight to finance, and the meeting stays the only thing on your desk.

replace_in_block.new_heading: How to compare corporate catering companies in Dubai
new_paragraphs: There is no official ranking of catering companies in Dubai, and any company claiming to top one is claiming it about itself. What you can compare, before you enquire, is what each firm will tell you in public. Does it publish a per-head price, a minimum headcount and a minimum order value? Will it name the chef who will be in your building? Does the quote itemise food, staff and equipment as separate lines, so finance can read it? Is one person accountable on the day, or does the booking pass between a sales desk and a kitchen? Ours are printed on this page, so you can hold them against anyone else. Our guide to choosing a catering company in Dubai sets out the full checklist.

replace_in_block.new_heading: Why choose myCHEF as your corporate catering company
new_paragraphs: MyCHEF was founded by a chef trained in some of Europe's most demanding kitchens on one idea: you own the meeting, we carry the work. That is why every chef clears the same gate before joining this corporate catering company in Dubai — identity checks, a practical cooking assessment, reference verification and ongoing performance reviews , a continuous standard, not a one-time tick. We are also straight with you: no system removes every risk, so we match each event to the right available chef instead of pretending the roster is interchangeable. For a corporate booking that is often Ahmed Al-Rashid — 18+ years across Dubai, London and Paris in classical French technique — who treats each menu as a collaboration with the host, every course timed, seasoned and plated so a full table is served at once. Booking a private corporate chef of that calibre is what separates the best corporate catering in Dubai from a tray delivery. We have delivered corporate galas and boardroom dinners across the city. Covers corporate catering; client reviews go up as events are delivered.

new_paragraphs: How much does corporate catering cost in Dubai?

From AED 90 per person for a dropped-off working lunch, AED 120 for a staffed event buffet and AED 150 for a premium spread with live stations. A chef cooking and serving on site is AED 700 to 950 per person. Minimums are 10 guests on volume formats, 20 on a buffet and AED 900 on order value; retained programmes are priced against the weekly or monthly schedule.
What is included in corporate catering services in Dubai?

Included as standard are menu design, a vetted chef and service team, delivery or on-site cooking, setup and cleanup, plus one contact and a single itemised invoice. You choose the format and we build the run sheet around it.
Can you handle daily office catering and one-off corporate events?

Yes — we run both daily and weekly office catering and one-off corporate events for parties, conferences and client dinners, held to the same standard whichever it is. Standing programmes get consistent menus and simplified billing.
Do you offer corporate catering packages and retainers?

Yes — corporate catering packages and retainer programmes are priced against your schedule, which usually works out better value than repeated one-off bookings. We scope the menu, headcount and service level once, then keep it consistent.
How do I hire a corporate caterer in Dubai?

To hire a corporate caterer in Dubai, send your date, headcount, venue and budget and we typically reply within 15 minutes during business hours, with an itemised proposal to follow, usually confirmed inside one business day.
Can you cater dietary requirements for our team?

Yes — every booking is planned for vegetarian, vegan, gluten-free, nut-free and other allergen needs, with labelled dishes. Menus are fully halal by default across our corporate food catering in Dubai.
How far in advance should we book?

Sooner is safer — 48 hours is workable for standard office catering, but a week or more is ideal for large corporate events, plated dinners and peak festive dates. Recurring programmes are set up once and then run to schedule.
Do you cover corporate catering near me across Dubai?

Almost certainly — our professional chefs reaches every Dubai business district and free zone, from Downtown and DIFC to Business Bay, JLT, Dubai Marina and Media City, matched to your venue and headcount.
What is the corporate catering contact number?

Call or WhatsApp +971 55 174 4849, or email hallo@mychef.ae. You can also send the brief through the contact form. We typically reply within 15 minutes during business hours, and the itemised proposal follows.
Where can I read corporate catering reviews?
We do not publish client reviews on this page, and we will not write ones we cannot attribute.Judge us on those, and on the proposal you get back.
What is the smallest corporate booking you take?

Ten guests on a dropped-off or working-lunch format, with a minimum order value of AED 900. Twenty for a full buffet. A private chef has no minimum headcount, so a board dinner for six is a normal booking at AED 700 to 950 per person.
For corporate catering, the chefs and partner kitchens handling your booking operate to Dubai Municipality food-safety requirements .

add_block.new_heading: Corporate catering for meetings, conferences and events
new_paragraphs: The format is set by the occasion, not the other way round. For an internal all-hands we run buffets and live stations that feed a floor quickly between sessions; for a client-facing corporate event catering in Dubai brief we move to plated service with timed courses and front-of-house staff. Conferences get grazing tables, working-lunch boxes and continuous coffee so the agenda does not stall at a catering queue. Product launches, award nights and the office festive party lean toward corporate party catering in Dubai — canapés, a manned bar of mocktails, and a dessert table that photographs well for the socials team. Whatever the room, we scope power, access, service windows and guest flow before the day, so the food arrives cooked, hot and on cue, not a last-minute scramble. Tell us the audience and the time you have, and we build the run sheet around it.

new_paragraphs: Your corporate menu in Dubai is built around your people, not a fixed printout. Popular builds include hot-and-cold working buffets, individually boxed lunches for hybrid teams, bowl-food for standing receptions, and a plated three- to five-course dinner for board level. Seasonal produce drives the specials, and portion planning is sized to real appetites so you neither run short nor bin trays of waste. Sample menus are shared before you commit, and we lock the final selection once headcount is confirmed.

add_block.new_heading: Small corporate catering: boardroom lunches and team dinners
new_paragraphs: Most corporate catering enquiries in Dubai are not galas. They are a lunch for twelve in a meeting room, a small party for a team that closed something, a leaving dinner for eight. Small corporate catering in Dubai works on the same terms as the large kind, with one number to know. Volume formats start at 10 guests and AED 900 on order value, which is ten people at the AED 90 working-lunch tier. Below ten, a dropped-off order does not clear that floor, and the format that fits is a chef in the room. A private chef carries no minimum headcount, so a board dinner for six at AED 700 to 950 per person is a normal booking. Small party catering in Dubai for a team celebration usually lands between the two: canapés or a short buffet at AED 120 to 150 a head once you are over twenty.
